introHtml: Recycled multi function tools let you promote sustainability without sacrificing utility. Made from post-consumer or post-industrial recycled materials, these tools appeal to eco-conscious clients and employees. Choose a carabiner-style tool with a bottle opener, screwdriver, and knife for a practical giveaway that aligns with your green initiatives. Decorate with a laser engraving or pad print to keep your logo visible while reducing environmental impact.
